data.name: Clarence
data.long_meaning: The name Clarence is derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning clear or bright. This name was popular among the early Christians and was given to children born during a time of clarity or revelation. In the Bible, the name is associated with St. Clarence of Amiens, a sixth-century French bishop who was known for his clear and inspiring teachings.
